The Morning

Valentine's Morning
Hearts, Roses & Promises

The day began with heart-shaped balloons floating beside a bouquet of red roses and baby's breath. Every petal whispered the same thing the balloons already said.

Stepping Outside
Two Shadows, Two Hearts

Even your shadows told the love story -- two silhouettes leaning close, heart balloons floating above like thoughts only you two could share.

The Date

Afternoon Sun
All Dressed Up, Nowhere But Together

Under swaying palms and golden light, two smiles that need no caption. She in her floral dress, he in his button-down -- dressed up for each other.

Nature's Canvas
Lauryn & the Emerald Spring

Spanish moss draping ancient oaks, crystal-green water glowing below. The most beautiful place deserved the most beautiful person standing in it.

Evening
Paella, Cocktails & That Look

A sizzling paella between you, cocktails in hand, and the kind of look that makes the whole restaurant disappear. This is what Valentine's dinner should feel like.

♥

Cooking with Love

The Weekend After
From Dough to Feast

The love didn't end on the 14th. Rows upon rows of hand-folded dumplings, a table overflowing with home-cooked dishes, red wine poured, roses watching from the corner. The best meals are the ones you make together.

Forever & Always

Every moment with you is a Valentine's Day.
Here's to a thousand more, Lauryn.
